objective: Test whether an ECLS-style interface likelihood shift or ProteinMPNN mutation likelihood ranks experimentally measured antibody-antigen ddG within complexes, beyond a 20-dimensional composition baseline.

data.antibody_filter: PDB must be present in local SAbDab summary with non-null Hchain and protein antigen_chain
data.excluded_reason: Fc receptor-Fc, enzyme-inhibitor, monobody-SH2, chemotaxis or cytokine receptor complexes; not antibody-antigen.

scores.dlogp_complex: sum_i logP(mut_i | complex backbone + rest of WT sequence) - logP(wt_i | same)
scores.dlogp_stripped: same, with the direct partner chain removed

analysis.primary_endpoint: within-complex Spearman(score, ddG); negative rho is the good direction (positive ddG = destabilizing)

gates.positive: dils has negative within-complex rho in >=70% of evaluable complexes AND paired dils-minus-composition rho difference has 95% CI upper < 0
gates.negative: otherwise; no model training, no claim upgrade
gates.claim_boundary: development benchmark on public antibody-protein ddG; not IDP/peptide binding, not affinity prediction, not a change to frozen ECLS/PAE results
